title: Inori's Homunculus Tears Yuri Novel Gets Manga by Ayster, Dokico
content:
German publisher Dokico announced on Saturday that Ayster will draw a manga adaptation of author Inori 's Homunculus Tears: Alchemy for the Brokenhearted ( Homunculus no Namida ~Kietai Kimi e no Renkinjutsu~ ) novel. Dokico will begin releasing the manga in German, English, and Japanese simultaneously in January 2027.

Inori offered the following statement regarding the manga adaptation:

“Homunculus Tears: Alchemy for the Brokenhearted” is getting a manga adaptation! Though the previous plans for it had to be canceled, the project has been restructured and is officially moving forward. [...]

I wrote this novel for my teenage self, who didn't believe she had a place in life, and for all those who have ever felt the same. It's a dear story to me, and although there have been many twists and turns, I have found an artist who understands its painful yet caring nature. I hope Ayster-sensei's Maha and Ruri will keep you company on a cold, lonely night, and I hope you're as excited about this adaptation as I am.

Ayster offered the following statement regarding the manga adaptation:

I'm honored to be drawing the manga adaptation of Homunculus Tears! I'll do my best to bring Maha and Ruri's story to life! Thank you for your support!

The announcement notes that there was an earlier announcement for a manga adaptation of the novel, which originally had Nata Ōkura and Kadokawa working on it, but the project fell through.

Inori self-published the original novel digitally in Japanese in April 2025, as well as in English in May 2025. Sekai Edition published the novel in Spanish, and Dokico handled the German release. Kevin Ishizaka worked on the novel's English translation. AONOSHIMO drew the illustration for the novel.

Inori describes the novel:

Amid a prolonged conflict between humans and demons, humanity stands on the brink. The protagonist, Maha, is a powerful human alchemist fighting on the frontlines. One day, however, Maha's mother, Diriyah—who is also an engineer—announces that she has achieved a breakthrough by successfully creating a “Homunculus” through the use of alchemy. According to Diriyah, with the Homunculus to stand in and fight, humanity can triumph over the demons without further sacrifice of human lives. Paying little heed to the rejoicing troops, Maha—who has only ever found purpose on the battlefield—is shaken by the prospect of losing the only meaning in life she has ever known. “If I'm not even expected to fight… What exactly am I supposed to do?” This is a story about overcoming the despair of having never wanted to be born.

Dokico announced on June 25 earlier this year that it will release its first original light novel series titled Poison for the Moon, Medicine for the Night—An Assassin Who Longs for Death and a Vampire Marked for Death ( Tsuki ni Doku, Yoru ni Kusuri: Shinitai Ansatsusha to, Shi wo Nozomareru Kyūketsuki ), under the company's Yurico project, with the first volume scheduled for release digitally worldwide in December. Inori is writing the story with illustration by Komizuki .

AONOSHIMO launched a manga adaptation of the novel series in Ichijinsha 's Comic Yuri Hime magazine in June 2020, where it is currently ongoing. Ichijinsha published the manga's 12th compiled book volume on April 17. Seven Seas Entertainment is also publishing the manga in English.

The series inspired a television anime adaptation that premiered in October 2023. Crunchyroll streamed the anime.

Inori launched the series' sequel titled I'm in Love with the Villainess: Come on and Notice Me Already ( Furimukinasai, Watakushi ni! ) with its first volume on January 26. Hanagata returned as the illustrator for the novel. The novel focuses on Rae and Claire's daughter Aleah. Seven Seas will release the novel in English in January 2027.

Inori launched a spinoff story titled Heimin no Kuse ni Namaikina! on Shōsetsuka ni Narō in May 2021, and ended it in October 2021. GL Bunko released the story in a digital novel volume in February 2022. Seven Seas Entertainment also released the novel spinoff with the title I'm in Love with the Villainess Spin-Off: She's so Cheeky for a Commoner .
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Renai Rubi no Tadashii Furikata Season 2 Reveals More Cast, October 29 Debut
content:
The official website for the second season of the live-action series of Ogeretsu Tanaka 's Renai Rubi no Tadashii Furikata (The Right Way to Write Love) boys-love manga revealed more cast members, the October 29 debut on Tokyo MX1, and a new visual for the second season on October 7.

The new cast members include:

• Rina Komiyama (upper left in image above) as Maki Oda

• Takumi Bandō (top center) as Kyōsuke Hiiragi

• Tamami Sakaguchi (upper right) as Matsuri Inui

The returning cast members from the first season include:

• Nanami Asahi (lower left) as Aoi Shiina

• Saya Emori (bottom center) as Reina Kaga

• Tetsunori Akira (lower right) as Hajime Kondō

Genki Iwahashi and Satoru Sōma reprise their roles as Hiromu Suzuki and Natsuo Washizawa, respectively.

Yasuki Satō returns to direct the second season, with Motoko Takahashi also returning to write scripts.

The first season debuted on Tokyo MX1 in July 2025.

The manga centers on Hiromu, who was once bullied by Natsuo in high school for his appearance and demeanor. After high school, Hiromu completely remade himself, going to beauty school and striving to make himself handsome. Now an adult working in a beauty parlor, Hiromu has a coincidental reunion with Natsuo, but Natsuo doesn't recognize him. After they grow closer and Natsuo admits he has feelings for him, Hiromu vows to break up with him in a grand way as revenge for being bullied.

Tanaka published the manga in 2015.

SuBLime previously released Tanaka's Yarichin Bitch-bu and Escape Journey manga in English. Yarichin Bitch-bu inspired an OVA adaptation in 2018. Tanaka's Happy of the End boys-love manga also inspired a live-action series in September 2024. Manga publisher KUMA licensed Tanaka's Mermaid Prince manga.

title: 'Kino no Tabi' Creator Duo Begins New Light Novel
content:
Publishing company Kadokawa announced on Friday that author Keiichi Sigsawa and illustrator Kouhaku Kuroboshi , the duo behind the Kino no Tabi: The Beautiful World ( Kino's Journey: The Beautiful World ) light novel, will launch a new light novel titled Drifted: John Smith no Edo Hyouryuu Kitan . Mobile online game developer coly is credited for the original concept. The first volume will be published under the Dengeki Bunko imprint on November 10.

Sigsawa began penning Kino no Tabi: The Beautiful World in the Dengeki hp magazine with illustrations by Kuroboshi in March 2000. Kadokawa published the first volume under the Dengeki Bunko label in July that year. The 24th volume went on sale in September 2025.

Tokyopop originally licensed the light novel in English and released the first volume in October 2006. However, due to issues with the licensor, the publisher was unable to release further volumes and its license for the series subsequently expired.

The first television anime adaptation directed by Ryuutarou Nakamura ( Serial Experiments Lain ) at A.C.G.T. aired in Spring 2003. A prequel and sequel movie were released in February 2005 and April 2007, with the latter being produced by Shaft .

ADV Films originally licensed the first television anime in North America and released it in four DVDs throughout 2004 with English subtitles and dub. Sentai Filmworks relicensed the anime and streamed it on HIDIVE with an English dub and sub.

A second television anime adaptation , directed by Tomohisa Taguchi ( Bleach: Sennen Kessen-hen ) at Lerche , aired in Fall 2017. Crunchyroll simulcasted the series with subtitles in multiple languages and an English dub.

Kino no Tabi: The Beautiful World ranked in the Best Light Novel category of the Kono Light Novel ga Sugoi! guidebook three times, placing 2nd in 2006, 5th in 2007, and 6th in 2008.

Synopsis John Smith, a former American soldier who washed ashore in late Edo-period Japan, is granted samurai status and the name Sumisu Jion by Shogun Tokugawa Ienari. His main duty is to investigate and recover modern firearms that have mysteriously appeared due to temporal distorsions, in a world also inhabited by superhuman ninja, sorcerers, and spirits. Smith undertakes these dangerous missions in the hope of one day returning to his homeland to reunite with his wife and children.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady's Treasure Film's New Video Reveals Bi Clan's Cast
content:
TOHO animation began streaming a character trailer for The Apothecary Diaries : The Late Lady's Treasure ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto: Bо̄hi no Hihо̄ ), the upcoming anime film based on Hyuganatsu and Touko Shino 's The Apothecary Diaries ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) light novel series, on Monday. The trailer highlights the Bi clan, and announces the cast members for the clan's important characters.

The cast members include ( Note: Character name Romanizations are not official ) Nobuo Tobita as Bi clan head Birō, Kumiko Watanabe as Birō's wife Shūu, and Hirofumi Nojima as the Bi clan's eldest son Bisen. The trailer also shows the previously revealed cast member Mariya Ise as key character and Bi clan son Mu Qing.

TOHO animation will present more character videos over the next two days: for the Kaja Troupe on October 13, and for Ruo Qing and Yi Shan on October 14 (all name Romanizations not confirmed).

The story follows Maomao and Jinshi as they travel to the hometown of a concubine who died five years ago in the imperial harem, to return her remains to her homeland. There, they encounter pirates, hidden treasures, the secret of the Empress' remains, and a mysterious boy who holds the key to the story.

The film will open in theaters in Japan on December 11 and feature a brand-new story by the original novel series' author Hyuganatsu . Mariya Ise joins the cast as Mu Qing (English romanization not confirmed).

Crunchyroll announced on Thursday it has acquired the North American and worldwide rights (excluding Asia but including India) to the film. Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment will announce the release date at a later time.

The third television anime season premiered on October 2 at 11:00 p.m. (10:00 a.m. EDT) in the "Friday Anime Night" programming block on NTV and 29 affiliated channels for its first cours (quarter of a year), and its second cours will premiere in April 2027.

The anime's first season premiered in October 2023 with the first three episodes, and aired for two cours . Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan and is also streaming an English dub .

The second anime season premiered in January 2025 on Nippon TV 's FRIDAY ANIME NIGHT programming block, and aired for two consecutive cours . Crunchyroll is streaming the second season, and it is also streaming an English dub .

J-Novel Club publishes the novel series digitally, and it describes the story:

In the East is a land ruled by an emperor, whose consorts and serving women live in a sprawling complex known as the hougong, the rear palace. Maomao, an unassuming girl raised in an unassuming town by her apothecary father, never imagined the rear palace would have anything to do with her—until she was kidnapped and sold into service there. Though she looks ordinary, Maomao has a quick wit, a sharp mind, and an extensive knowledge of medicine. That's her secret, until she encounters a resident of the palace at least as perceptive as she is: the head eunuch, Jinshi. He sees through Maomao's façade and makes her a lady-in-waiting to none other than the Emperor's favorite consort... so she can taste the lady's food for poison!

Hyuganatsu began serializing the story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" (Let's Become Novelists) website in October 2011. Shufunotomo began publishing the novels in print volume with illustrations by Shino in August 2014. Nekokurage launched an ongoing manga adaptation in Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine in May 2017. Square Enix Manga & Books is releasing the manga adaptation in English. The company is also publishing the novels in print. Viz Media is releasing Minoji Kurata 's separate manga adaptation titled The Apothecary Diaries: Maomao’s Notes on the Inner Palace .
author: ANN

title: Idol Group i☆Ris to End Activities in 2027
content:
Voice actress idol unit i☆Ris announced on Sunday on their official website that they will end their activities at the end of 2027, coinciding with the group's 15th anniversary and marking the conclusion of their 15-year journey.

In a statement , the staff apologized for the sudden announcement and thanked the fans and everyone involved with the group. They said the five members and staff have been talking it over since last year after the group's 10th anniversary in 2022."We will run to the end in true i☆Ris style," the statement read, with gratitude to fans "in our hearts."

The unit consists of Saki Yamakita (green; leader), Yuu Serizawa (blue), Himika Akaneya (purple), Yuki Wakai (red), and Miyu Kubota (orange). Each of them posted a message to fans.

Yamakita, the group's leader, said she originally planned to continue for ten years and was glad to pass that point with all five members. She said the group has yet to achieve a sold-out solo show at Yokohama Arena and wants to reach it in the remaining year.

Wakai said the decision was not prompted by any one person and was made after thorough discussion among the members. She said she began to think about an end to her idol career after the 10th anniversary and chose the 15-year mark to finish while the group is at its peak.

Serizawa told fans who were upset by the news that she was sorry to see them sad and asked them to spend the final year making memories they can look back on for the rest of their lives. Akaneya, who said she usually gets bored of things quickly, called this the longest she has stuck with anything. Kubota said she was a little glad if fans felt sad, because it showed how much the group meant to them. Several members closed with the same line, asking fans to "dream a little longer, just a little more" with them.

The group's 14th anniversary live is scheduled for November 3 at the Yokohama Arena. Kubota asked fans to come with their sadness if they must, but to bring plenty of excitement too. The statement did not announce details of further events before the end of 2027.

i☆Ris formed in July 2012, under the DIVE II Entertainment label by Avex and 81 Produce through the Anison Vocal Audition. The group debuted in November 2012, with the single Color . In addition to their music careers, all five members are also voice actresses, best known for performing songs for the PriPara anime franchise. The idol group also won the Best Vocal Performance Award at the 10th Seiyuu Awards in March 2016.

Over the years, i☆Ris performed theme songs for several anime, including Kenja no Mago ( Wise Man's Grandchild ), Sousei no Onmyouji ( Twin Star Exorcists ), Tejina-senpai ( Magical Sempai ), Mahou Shoujo Site ( Magical Girl Site ), and Kakegurui Twin , with the recent being Honoo no Toukyuujo: Dodge Danko ( Flaming Dodgeball Girl Danko ). The group also received an anime movie adaptation, i☆Ris the Movie: Full Energy!! , which premiered in Japan in May 2024 to celebrate their 10th anniversary.

title: This Breakout Action Hit Is Quickly Taking Over the Fall – Watch Opening
content:
The Fall 2026 anime season is finally here, and there’s no denying it’s one of the biggest quarters in a while. Most of the hype the season is getting is due to the sequels of The Apothecary Diaries and Black Clover. The hype around Black Clover Season 2 is greater than ever since the anime is returning after five years. As the largest streaming platform for anime fans across the world, Crunchyroll is streaming all the major releases of the season. The platform has exciting new lineups for each quarter and Fall 2026 is no different. However, along with the sequels, several exciting new debuts are also grabbing the spotlight this month.

One of them includes Overgeared, an anime based on a webtoon. The action fantasy surprisingly became a massive hit after its debut earlier this month. Although the manhwa has been ongoing since 2020, many fans just learned about the exciting series after the anime debut. The anime is scheduled for 12 episodes, which can only adapt the initial stages of the story. As this breakout hit grabs all the attention this month, it reveals its excuting opening and ending themes.

Overgeared Reveals Its Opening and Ending Themes

content:
The film is described as follows:

"Second-year high school student Aoi Aioi is an aspiring musician. Her older sister Akane's ex-boyfriend Shinnosuke Kanomura is a struggling guitarist. Aoi and Akane's parents passed away in an accident 13 years ago, and Akane gave up her ambition of going to Tokyo with Shinnosuke to take care of Aoi. Since then, Aoi has felt indebted to her older sister.

"One day, she is invited to perform at a music festival as a session musician by a famous en singer named Dankichi. At the same time, Shinnosuke returns to Aoi and Akane's town after a long time away. Then, Shinno mysteriously appears- who is actually Shinnosuke from 13 years ago after traveling from the past to the present-and Aoi falls in love for the first time."

Director Tatsuyuki Nagai , writer and director Mari Okada , and artist Masayoshi Tanaka — the members of Super Peace Busters — handled the film. Nagai directed, Okada penned the script, and Tanaka drew the original character designs and served as chief animation director. CloverWorks was in charge of animation production. Shion Wakayama , Riho Yoshioka , and Ryō Yoshizawa star in the film.

"At the Queen's request, Ciel and Sebastian investigate the Werewolves' Forest, where all who enter suffer a deadly curse. But when Ciel falls victim, Sebastian must serve a witch to obtain the cure, only to uncover secrets more dangerous than magic."

Daisuke Ono and Maaya Sakamoto are reprising their respective roles as the butler and demon Sebastian Michaelis and British noble Ciel Phantomhive.

Kenjirō Okada ( March comes in like a lion , RWBY: Ice Queendom ) once again directed the anime at CloverWorks . Returning staff from the Black Butler: Public School Arc anime included Hiroyuki Yoshino , who was again in charge of the series script, Yumi Shimizu as character designer, and Ryo Kawasaki , who again composed the music.

The Black Butler anime adapts Yana Toboso 's manga of the same name. The series premiered in Japan in 2008, and Black Butler II followed in 2010. Black Butler: Book of Circus premiered in 2014. Funimation has released all three television anime, the Black Butler II OAV project, the Black Butler: Book of Murder OAV , and the Black Butler: Book of the Atlantic anime film on home video.

"A seventh Singularity has been discovered in ancient Mesopotamia in the year 2655 B.C.

"The land of Uruk, governed by the wise King Gilgamesh after he returned from his quest for immortality, was grand and prosperous until three goddesses and countless Demonic Beasts appeared. These enemies have brought Uruk to the brink of destruction. With a Rayshift—a method of traveling across both time and space—Fujimaru and Mash journey to the land of Uruk, where they encounter the fortress city of Uruk and the Absolute Demonic Front, where a terrible battle against the fearsome onslaught of the Demonic Beasts rages."

CloverWorks ( DARLING in the FRANXX , PERSONA 5 the Animation ) produced the television anime series, with lead character designer Takeshi Takeuchi (Fate anime franchise ). Toshifumi Akai (assistant director DARLING in the FRANXX , Porter Robinson's "Shelter" director) directed the series, with assistant director Miyuki Kuroki ( The Idolm@ster SideM director). Tomoaki Takase ( Occultic;Nine , Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend ) was the character designer. Keita Haga ( Fate/stay night theme song lyrics) and Ryo Kawasaki ( Fate/Grand Order: First Order ) composed the music. Unison Square Garden performed the opening theme song "Phantom Joke."

title: Attack on Titan Kicks Off New World Tour With Classy Makeover
content:
Based on the acclaimed manga written and illustrated by Hajime Isayama, the anime adaptation of Attack on Titan reached unprecedented heights of popularity after its debut in 2013. While the first three seasons of the anime were adapted by WIT Studio, the final season saw a massive change. Due to the tight deadline, WIT Studio washed its hands of its flagship show, and MAPPA took it over. MAPPA wrapped up the entire story in the best way possible, preserving the legacy of this beloved show. However, while the story has long since ended, both seasons often return with new projects and exciting updates for fans.

Although there’s no hope for the anime’s return yet , the series has kicked off its first-ever orchestral concert tour of the series titled Attack on Titan: Symphony from Paradis . The project was announced in May this year, and it was confirmed to be produced by Wild Faery, an international production and promotion company that specializes in official live-to-film and symphonic concert experiences. The project kicks off with a gorgeous new visual of the beloved characters, as it puts Armin Arlet at the center as the conductor. It also includes Eren, Mikasa, and Levi in their uniform from before the time-skip, while the Colossal Titan is standing behind them.

Attack on Titan Is Holding Its First-Ever Orchestral Concert

The tour will take place in several regions in the USA, Europe, and Asia, starting from London’s Royal Albert Hall on October 17th, 2026. The official X handle of Wild Faery drops the latest visual to hype up the project while also confirming that the tickets at Royal Albert Hall have already been sold out. However, the orchestra will be held at various places until August next year, so make sure to check the ticket availability and schedule at the official website of Wild Faery . While the anime has previously held performances that blend rock and orchestra, the new concert will feature a full orchestra arrangement curated by the original composers. Over 100 musicians will participate in the performance, which is all the more reason why fans are hyped for this latest project.

Attack on Titan Has Another Major Project Planned For the Year

Although it’s impossible for the anime to return with a story since Isayama never created a sequel or spin-off after the manga’s ending, not even for one chapter. He has yet to return with a new story as well, although fans are eagerly awaiting their return. However, thanks to these new projects and visuals, Attack on Titan is still relevant to this day. Both animation studios revive the series in theatres with new versions of the already released episodes or compilations, but that’s all we can expect from the anime right now. While fans are enjoying updates on the world tour, we also can’t forget that MAPPA has another surprise planned for fans.

The studio will adapt the final storyline for the upcoming game, Attack on Titan 3 . The game is all to set to be released on December 10th, 2026, which gives fans something new to look forward to this year. Additionally, the series is also listed among the MAPPA projects that will be displayed during the 15th anniversary Expo. Even after the new project from MAPPA, we can expect more updates in the future, especially since September 9th has been declared as the official Attack on Titan Day. Not only will fans commemorate the series’ legacy on that day, but the franchise will keep returning with new projects.

title: Kino's Journey Light Novel Duo Launch New Supernatural Novel Series
content:
Kadokawa 's Dengeki Bunko imprint announced on Friday that Kino's Journey light novel duo writer Keiichi Sigsawa and illustrator Kouhaku Kuroboshi will launch a new light novel series titled Drifted ~John Smith no Edo Hyōryū Kitan~ (Drifted ~Strange Tale of John Smith's Drifting in Edo~). The first volume of the new series will ship on November 10.

The story centers on a man who wanders aimlessly, and the truths he witnesses, as he joins forces with ninjas, supernatural yōkai entities, and preternatural-powered beings to carry out his "jobs."

Sigsawa began serializing Kino's Journey in ASCII Media Works ' Dengeki HP magazine in 2000, and Kadokawa shipped the 24th volume in September 2025. The novel series inspired a 13-episode anime in 2003, followed by movies in 2005 and 2007. A remake television anime premiered in 2017. Sigsawa also published a spinoff series of the novels titled Gakuen Kino about Kino as a high school girl from 2006 to 2021. A manga adaptation of Gakuen Kino launched in Dengeki G's Festival! Comic magazine in 2010. The manga ended with its third compiled book volume in June 2012.

Iruka Shiomiya launched the first manga adaptation of the light novel series in Kodansha 's Shonen Magazine Edge in March 2017.

Yen Press recently announced on Friday that it has licensed the original novel series. Tokyopop published the beginning of the novel series in North America. ADV Films released the television anime adaptation. Sentai Filmworks rereleased the anime on DVD in June 2017.

Sigsawa and artist Hayato Asaki recently launched the Kemono-tachi no Peregrinatio (Peregrinatio Bestiarum or The Beasts' Wandering) manga on Shogakukan 's Weekly CoroCoro Comic online magazine on July 17. This is the first original manga written by Sigsawa.
